limitations: A failed structural gate stops the Jam successor before event protocol design and cannot be repaired from outcomes.
All archive bytes and canonical member identities must match the full-acquisition evidence before value parsing.
Correlation and tail concentration are descriptive diagnostics, not feature-selection or trade-threshold authority.
Development tail concentration is descriptive and cannot define an event cutoff.

DuckDB evaluates division through binary floating-point before the frozen eighteen-decimal output cast; synthetic conformance requires absolute error below one-billionth or relative error below one-trillionth against the Decimal reference.
Every feature row must remain inside the 2019-2020 development partition and obey the 133-minute warm-up.
No event cutoff, signal conjunction, candidate parameter, entry, exit, stop, target, or sizing rule may be defined.
No row may contain a future label, forward price, future return, trade outcome, strategy field, or PnL metric.
Only fixed marginal quantiles, moments, variability, monthly quality, pairwise correlation, and one-percent tail concentration may be reported.
Pairwise Pearson correlation measures linear dependence only and does not authorize feature removal.
Structural gates concern source integrity, completeness, readiness, finiteness, and feature variability only.
The 2021 sealed-validation and 2022 sealed-holdout archives may not be opened, parsed, joined, or summarized.
The consumed 2023-2025 and all 2026 Jam periods remain excluded.
The feature-row Parquet must be hash-bound, schema-checked, and contain exactly one row per development calendar minute.
The frozen development quarantine must be applied exactly; no missing minute or source defect may be synthesized.
The frozen seventeen-feature implementation may not be modified after seeing a development value.
The output calendar must contain every UTC minute from 2019-01-01 through 2020-12-31, including explicit non-ready states.
The result describes feature structure only and supplies no evidence of predictive power or profitability.
This protocol grants no strategy, signal, candidate, paper, Testnet order, production, live, capital, or profit authority.
This stage may read only the twenty-four frozen BTCUSDT aggregate-trade archives from January 2019 through December 2020.
